Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Advanced Project Buyer.
 If you think you'll like to manage the following responsibilities at higher standards:
Ensures production capacity at our suppliers for all parts under responsibility ordering in a timely manner necessary equipment (both capacity and replacement):
Analyzing at least once per quarter the global data and take the proper decision for equipment acquisition.
Use historical data and multiple sources of information in order to improve or extend the forecast visibility.
Align with global strategies of Product Area teams before launch.
Negotiate equipment cost contributing to limitation of investments and aligning to the budget.
Drive/order changes at suppliers requested by internal or external customers as resulted out of studies meant to improve robustness or reduce costs.
Ensures that implementation of additional capacity is done before risk identified through forecast analysis and escalate properly when additional bottlenecks are identified.
Strong connection with suppliers for good planning and coordination
Responsible for Autoliv Sourcing and Purchasing Process (ASPP)
Responsible for Purchasing deliverables in AS7 projects, e.g.:
Feasibility discussions
Sourcing (supplier nomination) process
Issue Purchase Orders
PPAP submission
Performs Sourcing Process (AS57) within project targets (Quality, Cost, Time) and Commodity strategy.
Ensures PPAP package delivery in time.
Strives to Purchasing KPIs fulfillment.
Seeks VEVA opportunities/cost improvement within projects or current production
Promotes and search for standardization, process improvements and innovation
Represents business interests of both ALV and suppliers
Builds partnership and maintains collaborative relationship within organization and with suppliers
Active member in project cross functional teams
 And If You Have/are
Technical University Degree (preferable)
Advanced communication skills in English
Flexible and adaptable
Purchasing experience in Automotive industry (preferable)
Analytical thinking
Persuasion and coordination skills
Good interpersonal and negotiation skills
Team works oriented & embraces cultural diversity
Organized, agile, committed & motivated person
Able to handle pressure and meet critical deadlines
Then we will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
 Our international work environment can offer you challenging and rewarding opportunities. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
 More lives saved – more life lived!
